markers.name: Velfa Roc

markers.name: Travelling Extraordinary Circus
markers.note: Roll up, roll up, this extraordinary circus is here for a limited time only.

markers.name: Cantigliale Melee
markers.note: Warriors from around the land gather for a melee of cunning in Cantigliale, with fame, fortune and favour on offer to the victor.

markers.name: Adfleva Fair
markers.note: A fair is being held in Adfleva, with all manner of local and foreign goods and services on offer.

markers.name: Minor Jetty
markers.note: A small location along the Chang River to launch boats from sits here, along with a weary looking owner, willing to sell passage along the river.

markers.name: Jaguars migration
markers.note: A huge group of jaguars are migrating, whether part of their annual routine, or something more extraordinary.

markers.name: Boridampo fete
markers.note: A fete has been organised at Boridampo as a chance to gather the local elders of the area together to be merry, make alliances and scheme around the crisis.

markers.name: Diaphanous mirage
markers.note: This diaphanous mirage has been luring travellers out of their way for eons.

markers.name: Picallepiet Chasm
markers.note: The Picallepiet Chasm. Locals claim that it is endlessly deep and unexplored.

markers.name: Chong Cemetery
markers.note: A foreboding necropolis shrouded in perpetual darkness, where eerie whispers echo through the winding corridors and spectral guardians stand watch over the tombs of long-forgotten souls.
